mapper.select: SELECT a.fbx01_box_id AS box_id , a.fbx01_crt_date AS crt_date , a.fbx01_crt_emp_id AS crt_emp_id , a.fbx01_title AS title , a.fbx01_note AS note , a.fbx01_status_cd AS status_cd , f_cdnm('FbxBoxStatus', a.fbx01_status_cd, a.fbx01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS status_name , (SELECT coalesce(count(*), 0) FROM fbx03_file WHERE fbx03_box_id = a.fbx01_box_id) AS file_count FROM fbx01_box a WHERE 1=1 AND fbx01_company_id = #{companyId} AND fbx01_title LIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY fbx01_crt_date DESC , fbx01_title

SELECT a.fbx01_box_id AS box_id , a.fbx01_crt_date AS crt_date , a.fbx01_crt_emp_id AS crt_emp_id , a.fbx01_title AS title , a.fbx01_note AS note , a.fbx01_status_cd AS status_cd , f_cdnm('FbxBoxStatus', a.fbx01_status_cd, a.fbx01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS status_name , (SELECT coalesce(count(*), 0) FROM fbx03_file WHERE fbx03_box_id = a.fbx01_box_id) AS file_count FROM fbx01_box a WHERE fbx01_box_id = #{boxId}
